First USDC blacklist request: law-enforcement request to freeze 100,000 USDC at 0xaa05...1ee0, Jun 2020
OFAC SDN designation of Tornado Cash and associated Ethereum addresses, 2022-08-08. Triggers Circle's follow-on blacklist action same day and next day.

Sealed ex parte Order of Attachment (2026-03-22) in Benson v. Islamic Republic of Iran, No. 1:26-cv-02327 (S.D.N.Y.) — ~1,335 judgment creditors of Iran (Willkie Farr & Gallagher) attaching USDT/USDC at 814 'John Doe' wallets (~113 ETH/Polygon, 44 BSC, ~657 Tron) securing $10,498,664,592; Tether and Circle named as garnishees. Appendix A was compiled by plaintiffs' expert (Inca Digital) from Iranian-exchange deposit addresses plus one-hop counterparties, which is how operational wallets such as DFINITY's ckETH minter and Goated.com were swept in (both labelled 'Nobitex_ir'). Circle blacklisted 84 Appendix-A EVM addresses on 2026-03-23; 22 were released 2026-03-26→04-14 while the order was in force, 1 on 04-22, and 60 more after the 2026-04-28 Amended Order vacated the attachment as to all Appendix-A wallets except TNiq (see CU-TRG-0066). Reporting at the time (CoinDesk 04-13) described only a 'sealed civil case'.

OFAC SDN designation (2026-03-12) of DPRK IT Worker Fraud Network: Yun Song-guk, York Louis Celestino Herrera, Nguyen Quang Viet, Do Phi Khanh, Hoang Van Nguyen, Hoang Minh Quang, Amnokgang Technology Development Company, Quangvietdnbg International Services Company. 21 cryptocurrency addresses designated across Ethereum, Tron, Bitcoin networks. Triggers Circle blacklist sweep of 21 EVM addresses across 6 chains on 2026-03-12.

OFAC designation (2025-11-04) of DPRK bankers and institutions laundering cybercrime and IT worker proceeds — 8 individuals + 2 entities, plus a 53-address crypto update to the SDN entry for Cheil Credit Bank (First Credit Bank). Circle executed a coordinated blacklist of 53 EVM addresses across 6 chains within minutes of the announcement.

OFAC 2022-11-08 Tornado Cash redesignation + 2022-11-09 darknet fentanyl supplier designation (Peijnenburg, De Koning, Grimm + 9 entities). Circle executed consolidated blacklist sweep on 2022-11-10 (ethereum, 53 addrs) and 2022-11-11 (avalanche, same 53 addrs).
OFAC SB0225: Garantex redesignation + Grinex designation + 3 executives + 6 companies + A7A5 Russian ruble token network. Circle same-day blacklist of 12 new addresses on 6 chains.
OFAC SB0068: Houthi arms procurement network — 8 crypto wallets, ~$1B illicit flow, Houthi-Russia-IRGC-QF axis.
OFAC 2026-01-30: First-ever IRGC-linked digital asset exchange designation — Zedcex, Zedxion, Babak Zanjani; 6 operational infrastructure addresses.
OFAC 2025-11-19: Coordinated Five Eyes action — Media Land / Aeza Group (Hypercore) / Volosovik bulletproof hosting + Ryan James Wedding trafficking network. Federal Register 2025-20573.
OFAC 2024-12-19 expansion of Sa'id al-Jamal (IRGC-QF-aligned Houthi financier) to add 5 crypto addresses, plus 12 individuals/entities.

OFAC SB0278: US-UK coordinated action against Prince Group TCO (Cambodia pig-butchering scam compounds). 146 SDN additions. DOJ civil forfeiture of 127,271 BTC (~$14.4B). FinCEN severed Huione Group from US financial system. Circle same-day blacklist of 4 EVM addresses × 6 chains + extras = 31 actions.
OFAC SB0248 (2025-09-16): Iranian shadow banking crypto network — Derakhshan, Alivand + 2 others; $600M+ flow to IRGC-QF / MODAFL via Iranian oil sales.
OFAC JY2213 (2024-03-27): First joint OFAC-OFSI crypto designation. Gaza Now Telegram media outlet + Al-Qureshi + Aakhirah Ltd + 2 individuals raising $4.5M crypto for Hamas post Oct 7 attacks.
OFAC 2025-02-11: Zservers Russia-based bulletproof hosting + 2 admins (Bolshakov, Mishin) supporting LockBit ransomware. Circle executed multi-chain blacklist 13 days later on 2025-02-24.

OFAC Tornado Cash DELISTING (2025-03-21, SB0057): Reversal of the Aug 8, 2022 Tornado Cash designation. 100+ ETH addresses removed from SDN. Triggered Circle UNBLACKLIST cascade on 2025-03-21 (47 actions, ethereum) and 2025-03-22 (493 actions, cross-chain). Represents first major OFAC delisting of a crypto designation following federal appellate rebuke.
Bybit Lazarus $1.5B hack consolidation address freeze request (Circle acted 2025-03-01, ~24hr after Tether)
Cetus Protocol $223M exploit response (Circle acted 2025-06-20, +29 days after incident)

OFAC 'Designation Update' (2026-07-01; no dedicated press release) adding 131 TRON (TRX) and 3 Monero (XMR) digital-currency identifiers to the existing SDN entry for ISIL KHORASAN (ISIS-K; FTO/SDGT, first listed 2015-09-29). Same-day Chainalysis/TRM analyses describe the wallets as donation addresses of ISIS-K's al-Azaim Media Foundation (~$1.4M received since 2023, flows to Syria-based exchangers). Circle blacklisted the EVM-key equivalents of all 131 TRX identifiers (a TRON address is base58check(0x41 + the 20-byte key) — the same key controls the 0x address on every EVM chain) on all six EVM chains the same afternoon (first tx 15:13 UTC), one tx per address per chain, in OFAC list order — 786 actions, the largest single-day USDC blacklist cluster in the dataset. Press coverage credited only Tether's freeze of the TRON balances.

OFAC designation (2026-05-20) of two Sinaloa Cartel / Los Chapitos money-laundering networks — Armando de Jesus Ojeda Aviles (primary launderer, successor to Mario Jimenez Castro; bulk cash → crypto → Mexico) and Jesus Gonzalez Penuelas — 11 individuals and 2 entities. Six ETH identifiers listed (5 Ojeda Aviles, 1 Alarcon Palomares). Circle blacklisted all six on all 6 EVM chains within ~10 minutes (15:19–15:28 UTC).

OFAC cyber-related designation (2026-07-13) of First VPN Service (1VPNS, Dnipro — VPN infrastructure sold to ransomware crews since 2014), its administrator Dmytro Rashevskyi, and cryptor vendor Yevgeniy Silayev, following the May 2026 Europol/FBI takedown. 20 digital-currency identifiers listed (XBT, ETH, LTC, ZEC, DASH, TRX, DOGE, SOL). Circle blacklisted the 3 ETH identifiers and the EVM-key equivalents of the 3 TRX identifiers on all 6 EVM chains the same day.

OFAC designation (2026-08-07) of the Shelbit Exchange network run by Siavash Kayvanpour — SHPS Shelbit (Georgia), Shelbit General Trading (UAE), Shelbit Technologies (Poland), Crypto Home DMCC and NFT Home DMCC — for moving funds to/from IRGC wallets and Nobitex, plus Aban Tether (Tehran) and a Titan Exchange / Bank-e Shahr network. 14 identifiers listed (XBT, ETH, TRX, BNB, SOL). Circle blacklisted the 4 ETH identifiers and the EVM-key equivalents of the 3 TRX identifiers on all 6 EVM chains the same day; the BNB and SOL identifiers are not EVM-derivable and were not blacklisted.

OFAC counter-terrorism designation (2026-06-22) of three individuals and six entities across Europe, the Middle East and West Africa for facilitating ISIS financial transactions, including France-based Miloud Abderrahmane (a.k.a. 'Ibrahim Ghazi'), linked to ISIL, listed with 2 TRX identifiers. Circle blacklisted the EVM-key equivalents of both on all 6 EVM chains the same day.

OFAC counter-terrorism designation (2026-07-23) of a senior Egyptian Muslim Brotherhood official plus three individuals and three entities providing material support to Hamas, including Istanbul-based Iraqi national Zaid Issam Ahmed Al-Jebouri (linked to El-Kahira for General Trading), listed with 7 TRX identifiers. Circle blacklisted the EVM-key equivalents of all 7 on all 6 EVM chains the same day.

OFAC 'Designation Update' (2026-04-24) adding 2 TRX digital-currency identifiers to the existing SDN entry for BANK MARKAZI JOMHOURI ISLAMI IRAN (Central Bank of Iran; [IRAN][SDGT][IRGC][IFSR], first listed 2010). The same-day press release concerns Iran's oil trade/shadow fleet and does not mention the identifiers. Circle blacklisted the EVM-key equivalents of both on all 6 EVM chains the same day.

OFAC 'Designation Update' (2026-07-14) adding 4 TRX digital-currency identifiers to the existing SDN entry for BANK MARKAZI JOMHOURI ISLAMI IRAN (Central Bank of Iran). The same-day press release concerns the Shamkhani shipping network and does not mention the identifiers. Circle blacklisted the EVM-key equivalents of all 4 on all 6 EVM chains the same day.

UK designation (2026-05-26, Russia regime; 18 additions in an A7/Garantex-related package) of EXMO EXCHANGE LIMITED (UK-incorporated crypto exchange, RUS3602) for supporting the Government of Russia via the Russian financial-services sector, listed with 3 TRON wallet addresses. No corresponding OFAC action. Circle blacklisted the EVM-key equivalents of all 3 TRON addresses on all 6 EVM chains the same day — a UK-only listing mirrored by Circle.

UK designation (2026-03-26, Global Human Rights regime) of XINBI COMPANY LIMITED (GHR0190; 'Xinbi Guarantee' — Southeast-Asian scam-centre guarantee marketplace) for enabling and profiting from scam-centre forced labour, listed with 2 Tron crypto addresses. No corresponding OFAC listing of these identifiers. Circle blacklisted the EVM-key equivalents of both on all 6 EVM chains on 2026-07-29 — 125 days after designation (other UK/OFAC mirrors in the dataset are same-day); no July trigger found.

Vacatur of the 2026-03-22 attachment as to all Appendix-A wallets except TNiq (2026-04-28), after plaintiffs narrowed the case (Amended Complaint 2026-04-26) to the two Tron wallets that OFAC had added to the Central Bank of Iran SDN entry on 2026-04-24; Circle was dropped as garnishee (stipulation of dismissal filed under seal 2026-05-21, ECF 48). Circle unblacklisted 46 of the still-frozen Appendix-A addresses on 2026-05-12 (42 Ethereum + 4 Polygon) and 14 on 2026-05-28 — 14 and 30 days after the vacatur; one Nobitex-labelled Ethereum address remained blacklisted as of 2026-08-21. No Circle statement found.

OFAC designation (2023-07-31, 'Treasury Designates Leaders and Financial Facilitators of ISIS and al-Qa'ida Cells in Maldives') of Ali Shafiu (Maldives national based in Afghanistan, linked to ISIL Khorasan) [SDGT], listed with one USDT-TRON identifier. Identifier listed only in TRON (TRX/USDT) form; Circle blacklisted the EVM-key equivalent on all EVM chains it issues USDC on. Circle acted on Polygon 2023-07-31, four further chains 2023-08-01, and Base on 2023-08-18 (native-USDC launch replay).

OFAC designation (2024-03-20) of Ilya Gambashidze (Moscow; Social Design Agency / Russian government-directed disinformation operations) [RUSSIA-EO14024], listed with two USDT-TRON identifiers. Identifier listed only in TRON (TRX/USDT) form; Circle blacklisted the EVM-key equivalent on all EVM chains it issues USDC on. Circle acted 2024-03-21 on all six chains.

Circle acted 2023-10-04 on all six chains; this resolves part of the previously untriggered 2023-10-04 cluster.

OFAC designation (2025-07-01, 'Treasury Sanctions Global Bulletproof Hosting Service Enabling Cybercriminals and Technology Theft', SB0185) of Aeza Group LLC and affiliates/leadership [CYBER4][CAATSA - RUSSIA], listed with one USDT-TRON identifier. Identifier listed only in TRON (TRX/USDT) form; Circle blacklisted the EVM-key equivalent on all EVM chains it issues USDC on. Circle acted the same day on all six chains. (Distinct from the 2025-11-19 Media Land / Aeza Hypercore action, CU-TRG-0047.)

OFAC designation (2025-09-24, 'Treasury Sanctions Indian Nationals and Online Pharmacy for Supplying Counterfeit Fentanyl-Laden Pills', SB0261) of India-based Sadiq Abbas Habib Sayyed [ILLICIT-DRUGS-EO14059], listed with one TRX identifier. Identifier listed only in TRON (TRX/USDT) form; Circle blacklisted the EVM-key equivalent on all EVM chains it issues USDC on. Circle acted the same day on all six chains (one chain twice).

TRO-stage order (2026-05-29) in a civil suit alleging Overnight Finance founder Maxim Ermilov diverted >$15M from treasury wallets; Circle — a named defendant — was directed to block USDC at the address that received ~12.4M USDC on 2026-05-11, which is Zama's Confidential USDC (cUSDC) wrapper contract. Circle blacklisted it 2026-05-30 01:08 UTC (tx 0x6e24a776…), freezing 12,606,386 USDC belonging to ~1,500 unrelated depositors. Lifted after the 2026-06-01 hearing (CU-TRG-0076).

After the 2026-06-01 TRO hearing the court lifted the 2026-05-29 block directive; Circle unblacklisted Zama's cUSDC contract the same day (18:58 UTC), restoring access to ~12.5M USDC after a ~66-hour freeze. First litigated reversal of a civil-order Circle freeze in the dataset (a stipulated consent TRO followed on 2026-06-05 without a USDC block).
